title: Itangazo ry'Abarohamye
intro: Tekereza umutegetsi ukomeye akikijwe n'ubwiza, inzibutso n'ingabo zumvira itegeko rimwe. Uyu muntu yihaye ububasha buhebuje, yirengagiza ibimenyetso by'Imana nk'ibihimbano, maze ategeka ko bakomeza gukurikira inyanja. Kurikira inzira kuva ku mategeko y'ubwibone kugeza ku mazi yagabanutse, aho kwemera kwa nyuma kugera igihe bitinze cyane ku buryo umuntu atabasha gukiza.
clues: Nari mfite ububasha busesuye kandi nahinduye imbata y'abana ba Isirayeli munsi y'ubutegetsi bwanjye.
Navuze ko ndi umutegetsi usumba byose kandi nanze kwemera imana iyo ari yo yose indusha.
Nategetse Hamani kunyubakira umunara muremure kugira ngo ndebe Imana ya Musa.
Nahanganye na Musa na Harun ubwo bazanaga ibimenyetso bisobanutse neza, maze nyita ibitangaza byabo ubupfumu.
Nakurikiye Musa n'abizera hamwe n'ingabo zanjye nijoro kugeza tugeze ku nyanja.
Navuze ko nemera ubwo narohamaga mu nyanja, ariko byari byaratinze, maze umurambo wanjye urabikwa nk'ikimenyetso.

trial.label: Igeragezwa/Ikibazo
options: Yajugunywe mu muriro wabaye ukonje kandi ufite umutekano
Yubatse ubwato kugira ngo arokoke umwuzure ukomeye
Yaryamanye n'abagenzi mu buvumo imyaka myinshi
Yarohamye ubwo yakurikiranaga Musa n'Abisirayeli mu nyanja yari yagabanutsemo kabiri
trial.answer: Yarohamye ubwo yakurikiranaga Musa n'Abisirayeli mu nyanja yari yagabanutsemo kabiri

outcome.label: Ibisubizo
options: Yababariwe kandi ahabwa ingoma y'amahoro igihe kirekire
Baguye mu kaga kandi umubiri wabo warafunzwe nk'ikimenyetso cy'abazaba nyuma
outcome.answer: Baguye mu kaga kandi umubiri wabo warafunzwe nk'ikimenyetso ku bari nyuma

arabic: ءَآلْـَٔـٰنَ وَقَدْ عَصَيْتَ قَبْلُ وَكُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
verse: Now? And you had disobeyed [Him] before and were of the corrupters? (10:91)
